description_en: Unlocks a database account of an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于解锁RDS PostgreSQL实例的数据库账号
kebab_example: aliyun rds unlock-account --db-instance-id pgm-bp0000 --account-name testaccount --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnlockAccount

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The account that you want to unlock. You can unlock a single account at a time
parameters.help_zh: 要解锁的账号名称。单次只能解锁一个账号
parameters.name: account_name
